pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Chelyabinsk, 9.Bxf6
pages.notes: Overview spoke of the b5-knight being displaced (it is on a3) and open files; plan 1 wrote the knight route as c2-e3; plan 2 played ...f5 before recapturing on f6. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Chelyabinsk, 9.Bxf6 gxf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 expanded with a3-b4 with a knight on a3; plan 3 wrote b1-c3 as a route; the overview called the g-file open. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 and fixed the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Chelyabinsk, 9.Nd5 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 2 assumed Bxf6 gxf6 in a line where Black recaptures with the bishop. Rewrote plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Chelyabinsk, 9.Nd5 Be7, 11.c3 Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 traded the g5-bishop for a knight on f3 that isn't there. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Chelyabinsk, 9.Nd5 Be7, 11.c3 O-O 12.Nc2 Bg5 13.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 traded the g5-bishop for a knight on f3 that isn't there; plan 4 rerouted an f6-bishop that stands on g5; plan 1 sent the knight via a1. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Haberditz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a d6-pawn not yet there and missed the Nd6+ threat; plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Sveshnikov, 11.c3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 4 offered ...d5 with White's knight on d5. Rewrote plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan, Sveshnikov, 11.c3 Bg7 12.exf5 Bxf5
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...f4 with the bishop on f5 blocking the f7-pawn and called the g-file open; plan 4 offered ...d5 with White's knight on d5; plan 1 wrote the route as c2-e3. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Pelikan/Sveshnikov, 6.Nbd5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight and used 'the f5 square for a knight'. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Accelerated Dragon, Modern Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 offered White the Maroczy Bind with c4, which the c3-knight blocks; plan 1 delayed ...d5 with ...a6 and ...b5 rather than playing it in one move. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Loewenthal, Kalashnikov, Main Line, 9.Be2
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-15: plan 4 was vague. Rewrote plan 4 around ...Bg5 (reviewer: first draft's queen set-up was not standard).
